instruction: I want to disable the background cone icon in VLC for a cleaner interface. The cone icon in the playlist is distracting. How do I turn it off?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the background cone icon in VLC (qt-bgcone=0). Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric to verify the setting in vlcrc config file. Default value is 1 (enabled), task sets it to 0 (disabled).
